name: Name
ownerHelp: Who owns the schema. If you leave it empty, it's owned by the user you connected with.
grantsHelp: Permissions on the new schema, granted in the same script.
scriptHint: This is what will run. It doesn't run until you confirm.
scriptEmpty: Type a name to see the script.
incomplete: Complete or remove the permissions without a user or without privileges.
dropIntro: The schema «{{name}}» will be dropped from {{db}}.
cascadeHelp: Also drops all the objects it has. This can't be undone.
notEmpty: While it has objects, the server will reject the drop.
confirmDrop: Drop the schema «{{name}}» from {{db}}? This can't be undone.
confirmDropCascade: Drop the schema «{{name}}» from {{db}} with all its objects? This can't be undone.
